title: S. cerevisiae Δpho84 Complementation: Growth Curves
author: David S Milner
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kw5cxg6
materials: Inoculate 100 µl into a 96 well plate.

steps.title: Prepare Expression Vector
steps.instruction: Synthesise the ORF, codon-optimised for expression in Saccharomyces cerevisiae, including a C-terminal His6 tag, and clone it into p416 GPD under the control of the constitutive GPD promoter (pXXX).

steps.title: Transform Yeast Strains
steps.instruction: Transform the specified S. cerevisiae strains with the appropriate plasmids.

substeps.instruction: Transform strain BY2959 (pho84::HIS3) with either p416 GPD or pXXX.
Transform strain BY5676 with p416 GPD to serve as a positive control.

steps.title: Initial Cell Growth
steps.instruction: Grow each strain in triplicate (3 independently obtained transformants) in Sc-ura medium.

substeps.instruction: Use Sc-ura medium consisting of 0.79% yeast nitrogen base without amino acids (Formedium), 700 mg L-1 complete supplement mix - ura (Formedium), and 2% glucose.
Incubate at 30°C with 200 rpm shaking for 16 hours.

steps.title: Wash and Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest and prepare cells for growth curve analysis using low-phosphate (LPi) medium (pH 4.5).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge cells at 1,810 x g for 3 minutes.
Wash the cells twice with LPi medium (pH 4.5).
Resuspend cells in LPi medium and dilute to an OD600 of 0.1.

steps.title: Perform Growth Curve Analysis
steps.instruction: Monitor cell growth using a Fluostar Omega Lite microplate reader (BMG Labtech Ltd.).

substeps.instruction: Maintain continuous double-orbital shaking (200 rpm) between reads.
